nodes.label: hb_init()
nodes.desc: L207: callocs hb_handle_t, sets HB_STATE_IDLE under state_lock, starts the 'libhb' monitor thread.

nodes.label: hb_start()
nodes.desc: L1995: zeroes progress fields, sets HB_STATE_WORKING, calls hb_work_init() at L2019 to launch the 'work' thread.

nodes.label: hb_pause / hb_stop
nodes.desc: L2026/L2070: pause flips HB_STATE_PAUSED; resume credits st_paused so ETA stays honest; stop only sets work_die=1.

nodes.label: hb_global_init()
nodes.desc: L2153: registers every work object into the hb_objects linked list (L2170-2198), inits buffer pool and builtin presets.

nodes.label: thread_func monitor
nodes.desc: L2255: 'libhb' thread polls scan/work threads every 50 ms and publishes HB_STATE_SCANDONE (L2294) / HB_STATE_WORKDONE (L2306).

nodes.label: hb_scan()
nodes.desc: L377: scan entry; returns immediately with HB_STATE_SCANDONE when the same path+title was already scanned; preview_count < 0 means 10.

nodes.label: HB_STATE_* defines
nodes.desc: L1469-1476: IDLE/SCANNING/SCANDONE/WORKING/PAUSED/WORKDONE/MUXING/SEARCHING, plus hb_state_t with progress, rate and eta_seconds fields.

nodes.label: hb_get_state()
nodes.desc: L2092: UI read-side; copies state under state_lock and demotes one-shot SCANDONE/WORKDONE back to IDLE.

nodes.label: InitWorkState()
nodes.desc: L67: resets working state per pass (progress 0, hours/minutes/seconds -1) before each do_job pass.

nodes.label: UpdateState()
nodes.desc: L3242: progress = frame_count/est_frame_count; rate_cur from a 4-sample sliding window; ETA = remaining_frames / rate_avg broken into hours/minutes/seconds (L3287-3291).

nodes.label: UpdateState3()
nodes.desc: L2055: scan progress blends title index and preview fraction (0.5/0.5 weighting across title and preview phases).

nodes.label: state JSON fields
nodes.desc: L89: exposes ETASeconds plus Working/Progress/Rate to JSON API consumers.

nodes.label: work_func()
nodes.desc: L107: the 'work' thread loop; expands JSON jobs, splits multi-pass encodes via hb_job_setup_passes (L152), forces a rescan after each job (L179).

nodes.label: do_job()
nodes.desc: L1716: sizes and wires the fifos (L1920-1927), chains reader -> decoders -> sync -> filters -> encoder -> muxer into job->list_work.

nodes.label: hb_get_work()
nodes.desc: L187: walks hb_objects and clones the work object by id; hb_video_decoder (L221) and hb_video_encoder (L239) sit on top.

nodes.label: init & launch loop
nodes.desc: L2216-2234: calls w->init() for every work object, then hb_thread_init(w->name, hb_work_loop, w) one thread per stage.

nodes.label: hb_work_loop()
nodes.desc: L2422: per-worker loop: hb_fifo_get_wait on fifo_in, invoke w->work(), push result downstream; sleeps while fifos are full, exits on *done/die.

nodes.label: filter_loop()
nodes.desc: L2506: same loop shape for filter objects, propagating chapter marks across dropped frames.

nodes.label: hb_fifo_* primitives
nodes.desc: hb_fifo_init (L1194), hb_fifo_get_wait (L1269), hb_fifo_full_wait (L1380), hb_fifo_push (L1436): mutex+semaphore queues.

nodes.label: struct hb_work_object_s
nodes.desc: L1554: init/work/close/info/bsinfo entry points, fifo_in/fifo_out, done/die flags, thread handle and next pointer.

nodes.label: hb_reader
nodes.desc: L18: WORK_READER object; demuxes BD/DVD/file via hb_psdemux_t and pushes packet buffers downstream.

nodes.label: hb_scan_init()
nodes.desc: L89: clamps preview_count to at least 3 (L114-116), sets HB_STATE_SCANNING, spawns the 'scan' thread.

nodes.label: ScanFunc()
nodes.desc: L140: iterates titles, calls DecodePreviews (L305-320) to probe streams and fill hb_title_t.

nodes.label: DecodePreviews()
nodes.desc: L760: decodes N preview frames per title for crop detection, audio, and subtitle analysis.

nodes.label: hb_decavcodecv
nodes.desc: L2201: 'Video decoder (libavcodec)'; decavcodecvWork (L1862) and decodePacket (L1763) drive avcodec_send_packet/receive_frame (L1420/1430).

nodes.label: hb_decavcodeca
nodes.desc: L66: 'Audio decoder (libavcodec)'; decavcodecaWork (L629) with the same send/receive pattern (L921/936).

nodes.label: hb_filter_init()
nodes.desc: L5628: builds filter objects by id (decomb, detelecine, crop/scale, render sub...); do_job chains them with FIFO_MINI queues.

nodes.label: hb_avfilter_graph_init()
nodes.desc: L39: allocates an AVFilterGraph (L61), creates buffer source/sink, parses user avfilter strings for passthrough of arbitrary FFmpeg filters.

nodes.label: hb_sync_video
nodes.desc: L3068: syncVideoInit (L2315) estimates est_frame_count; syncVideoWork (L3016) aligns frames on timestamps and feeds UpdateState.

nodes.label: hb_encavcodec
nodes.desc: L83: 'FFMPEG encoder (libavcodec)'; encavcodecInit (L349) selects MPEG-4/2, VP8/9, and NVENC/VAAPI/VCE/QSV/MediaFoundation hardware paths.

nodes.label: hb_muxer
nodes.desc: L770: WORK_MUX muxer; muxWork (L368) interleaves tracks and writes the output file; added last to list_work.

nodes.label: hb_thread_init()
nodes.desc: L1021: pthread_create wrapper (L1034); hb_lock/hb_unlock (L1125/1130), hb_yield (L1191), Win32 gettimeofday emulation (L91-100).
